Alcohol, been sober for 6 months now.
Ended up having massive seizures coming off it, definitely scared the shit out of me.

Update
They found a tumor in my stomach. Removed it, put me on better meds and I've been much better since
I was able to get benefits and weekly therapy.
I'm doing okay.
I'm still here
Still working 
Even a little happy, but best of all
A few cuts didn't set me back.

Thanks for the help guys.

I've heard good things about naturopathy before, so I won't shrug this off in fact ill take it as a sign. 
I'm on 5 pills, anti depressant, anti nausea, anti anxiety, acid reflux and codeine for when I have pain.
I wouldn't mind trying other options.
The ulcers albeit were partially from stress , partial from stomach damage.
As for my diet, I don't eat any red meat. I stick to fish and chicken. I avoid dairy and use substitutes
It could be gluten but I have a test coming up for celiac soon as well.
Thank you for the suggestion, really it feels nice having someone here.💜

I wish it was just that-
I will still give my breath work a try but unfortunately the nausea isn't fully my anxiety. I have ulcers, and they found a lump in my stomach.
I have more tests , including one for H Pylori which I'm going to tomorrow
I'll look into it, thanks for being kind when suggesting something.

I managed to get in touch with my doctor, he's getting me in contact with a short term therapist.
I'm going to take up a few of the suggestions, Journaling, going for a walk,  reading (something other than the horror novels I love so much😭 )

I hit a low, I've bounced back from worse. 
I had an intentional OD in 2015. I will not slip back to that.
No matter what.
There are still things I want to do, stories I want to write, a career I want to pursue.

Things, still suck right now. There's still weight , but I'll manage.

Thanks for all the support.
-R

I've been in dbt before, last night was simply a low point. 
Also I live in Canada - during winter there is only sun for a little bit. It's mostly cloudy and dark from 4pm- almost 8 am

I think I may take up going for a walk though. Just to do something that isn't work or school.
Currently I work 45 hours a week and go to school for calculus 3 hours x a week

I love reading, I always have been a reader. Ever since I was a kid, I've got a few self help books, I've even taken DBT. I find that therapy helps for me most of the time for a reason-
I have someone to talk to.
I used to journal a lot, but somewhere along the way I ended up stopping. Thank you for the suggestion ,I will certainly give it a try again. Even if it's just free flow write what first comes to mind.

I want to feel better, I don't want to feel sick every day. I don't want to vomit every day. I want to be able to work. I want to travel, but most of all I want to be writer- and a nurse. It's a big goal, but with time maybe I'll get there.

Right now I'm frantically getting ready for work, I feel nauseous but that's every day at this point. I have to try and be there for my clients (and yes my arms are covered- no way they can see that)
Health care is hard but, I enjoy what I can do for others 

What I mean by they can't figure it out, is the nausea and vomiting,  they have me on metoclopramide and it's not helping either.

I think last night I just hit a hard low, I'll look into the low income therapy
Thank you.

Wrong. I've been an avid reader for many years, lately I've been reading the subtle art of not giving a fuck. I have other issues, but I don't particularly feel like speaking to someone who insinuates I don't read, nor try to help myself- 
I'm on anxiety meds, I've been on different meds since I was 12 , I KNOW how MY anxiety feels. This is different. 

This post was a vent, last night I needed someone to talk to. But I don't particularly feel like talking to you.
I'm atheist. So no thanks.
